title: Normalized coefficient operations on an open pro-etale slice
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and any open immersion e:V to W, there exist the specified IntegralOpenReduction.Operations [def-sf-integral-open-operations] [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Operations here retain the actual slice-site continuous pushforward functors, constant-section normalization, all completed quotient projections, strict system transport, and section-normalized evaluation comparisons. No completeness predicate is imposed.

source.place: Tags 098K, 03DI, 03DJ and 0941; open slice equivalence and constant coefficient/strict system transport.

proof.text: Use the open slice equivalence to identify each finite constant coefficient sheaf; pullback-sheafification compatibility fixes the maps on constants. The quotient squares commute by uniqueness of sheafification extension.

Inverse image along the open immersion preserves limits. Take the inverse limit of the compatible finite coefficient isomorphisms to construct the completed map, its inverse and all the specified projection equalities.

Transport module sheaves and the coefficient sequence site by the actual site equivalence and these ring isomorphisms. The functors are the recorded continuous pushforwards; restriction of sections gives the evaluation comparisons and identity formulas. Equip them with the normalized localized direct-sum extension adjunction to obtain Operations.
